title: Extend bag verify/info to validate files_watch (Plan-32 follow-up)
body: Follow-up to PLAN-31: NEXBags (v0.2) reserve files/watch topic. Extend replay bag verify/info/cat to validate a files_watch topic when present: compute sha256/lines/time_range for files/watch.ndjson; surface counts.files_watch in manifest summary; cat supports files/watch. Add tests and docs.
